correctness.rationale: Every binary-meet-preserving unary map on a finite chain is monotone. The Pos axiom reduces exactly to f(u)>=u; the Con axiom reduces exactly to the disjunction f(ell)<=ell or constancy on the initial segment through ell. Those two conditions partition the valid maps into disjoint split and upper-constant normal forms in each parity. Stars-and-bars and hockey-stick identities establish each closed formula, and the central binomial asymptotic establishes normality proportion 1/2 and exponentially vanishing failure of center preservation. The independent direct-axiom program tested every monotone map on n=2..9 and matched both the criterion and all counts. No finite experiment is used as a proof of the all-size claims.

value.rationale: Finite involutive Kleene chains are the canonical bounded linear models of a recently defined modal Kleene variety, with natural centered versus noncentered and normal versus nonnormal subfamilies. The theorem supplies all-size isomorphism spectra and a structural normal form rather than arbitrary table entries; the asymptotic normal/center contrast quantifies distinct algebraic restrictions and gives exact benchmark families for model construction and comparison. The claim is neither a renaming of a known table nor an unmotivated isolated finite example.
